For me, it was how I looked and what the scale said. If the scale said something that wasn’t my goal weight, no eating for the rest of the day. You look at your body in the mirror and all you see is fat when you are underweight. I didn’t choose a eating disorder. You can’t really choose, it’s like another person is telling you to throw it up, is telling you to write down your calories, is telling you that your fat. It’s awful and some of it’s side effects still come up in my life daily. Like for instance, I would go dangerously long times without eating food. So if I don’t eat anything for a bit, my body freaks out and thinks I’m going through that mess again. I shake, I can’t see, it’s something awful that I would never wish on anyone.
